```{r}
#| label: setup
#| output: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Load the project's functions from the checkout (decision 0042) and read the
# published data bundle, so this code reproduces the figure (decision 0040).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT")
if (!nzchar(root)) root <- pkgload::pkg_path()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggiraph)

con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
release <- data_release_date()
last_season <- 2025L # the 2026 season is still being played
team_draft <- tbl(con, "team_draft") |> collect()
roster <- tbl(con, "roster") |>
  filter(season <= last_season) |>
  distinct(playerId, season, position) |>
  collect()
player_stats_seasons <- tbl(con, "player_stats") |>
  distinct(playerId, season) |>
  mutate(has_stat = TRUE) |>
  collect()
```

```{r}
#| label: compute
# Credited picks: players whose final college season was 2013 to 2025,
# approximately the draft classes of 2014 to 2026.
credited <- filter(team_draft, season >= 2013L, season <= last_season)
group_picks <- credited |>
  group_by(group = position_group) |>
  summarise(picks = sum(n_drafted), .groups = "drop")
roster_stat <- roster |>
  left_join(player_stats_seasons, by = c("playerId", "season")) |>
  mutate(
    group = position_group(position),
    has_stat = coalesce(has_stat, FALSE)
  )
ol_cov <- roster_stat |>
  group_by(group) |>
  summarise(
    seasons = n(),
    with_stat = sum(has_stat),
    share = mean(has_stat),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  left_join(group_picks, by = "group") |>
  mutate(pick_share = picks / sum(picks)) |>
  arrange(share)
ol <- filter(ol_cov, group == "Offensive line")
```

```{r}
#| label: figure
p <- ggplot(
  ol_cov,
  aes(share, reorder(group, share), fill = group == "Offensive line")
) +
  geom_col_interactive(
    aes(
      tooltip = paste0(
        group, ": ", fmt(with_stat), " of ", fmt(seasons),
        " roster seasons with a stat line (", pct(share), ")\n",
        fmt(picks), " credited draft picks (", pct(pick_share), " of all)"
      ),
      data_id = group
    ),
    width = 0.75
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = pct(share, 0)),
    hjust = -0.15,
    size = 5,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(`TRUE` = "#374151", `FALSE` = "grey65"),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(0, 0.8)) +
  labs(
    title = "Stat-line share by position group",
    subtitle = "The offensive line is in dark grey; hover a bar for counts",
    x = "Roster seasons with a stat line",
    y = NULL,
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card()

card_thumbnail(p, "offensive-line-stat-lines", release = release)
card_interactive(p)
```

```{r}
#| label: table
ol_cov |>
  transmute(
    group = group,
    seasons = fmt(seasons),
    with_stat = fmt(with_stat),
    share = pct(share),
    picks = fmt(picks),
    pick_share = pct(pick_share)
  ) |>
  knitr::kable(
    col.names = c(
      "Position group", "Roster player-seasons", "With a stat line",
      "Share with a stat line", "Credited draft picks", "Share of picks"
    ),
    caption = "Roster player-seasons and how many carry a stat line, with credited draft picks for the classes of 2014 to 2026, by position group. The share of picks shows how much of the draft each group supplies."
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: codes
by_code <- roster_stat |>
  mutate(position = coalesce(position, "None listed")) |>
  group_by(position, group) |>
  summarise(seasons = n(), share = mean(has_stat), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(is_ol = group == "Offensive line")
p_codes <- ggplot(by_code, aes(share, reorder(position, share), color = is_ol)) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(x = 0, xend = share, yend = reorder(position, share)),
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_point_interactive(
    aes(
      size = seasons,
      tooltip = paste0(
        position, " (", group, "): ", fmt(seasons),
        " roster seasons, ", pct(share), " with a stat line"
      ),
      data_id = position
    )
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(`TRUE` = "#374151", `FALSE` = "#6b7280"),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  scale_size_area(max_size = 9, guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(
    x = "Roster player-seasons with a stat line",
    y = "Roster position code",
    title = "Share with a stat line, by roster position code",
    subtitle = "Offensive-line codes in dark grey; dot size is roster seasons",
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_cfb2nfl(base_size = 13)
card_interactive(p_codes)
```
